notes.title: Update v 1.02
notes.notes:
Some bugs have been fixed. 
For those who have completed the NPC mission in the desert, there is a new chest at the entrance. Inside you will find:
Recipe for new weapons.
16 gold.
2 Queen Bees.

Fixed:
Some animals did not give experience.

Increased XP:
Trees on both maps.
On some enemies.

notes.title: No Man`s Island Prologue date of release 🏝
notes.notes:
We are pleased 🥳 to announce that the prologue of the game No Man`s Island🚣 will premiere on 01.08.2022 during Steam Survival Fest. If you are a fan of survival combat we invite you to play.
In the prologue you can expect
- more items,
- brand new ice biome, 
- quest system 
- radar
- boses, 
- new dungeons and much more

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.06 No Man's Island Demo
notes.notes:
Welcome to No Man's Island! Today we are launching the demo version 1.06 of our game and we are so excited about it! We listened to your feedback and made a lot of changes. If you have an idea how we could improve the game, please let us know in the feedback section or send us a message. So go ahead, play and enjoy!

Patch notes "Demo 1.06": 



 New tool: Sickle, now you need the Sickle to get Fiber and Wheat.

 New Level system: In the Carfting window, now you have to level up to unlock more things to craft (test phase)

 New Pet: Neutral, it only helps you search for hidden treasures underground. click on the pet and select Tame.

 New UI system, now if you don't have the tool, a message will appear on the screen with the image of the tool you need.

 You start with an Object (Flag) mark your house on the map, it can be picked up and placed wherever you want.

 More copper mines have been added to the map.



 Craft cost has been reduced:

[olist]
 Arrows
 Foundation
 Wall
 Wall with window
 Stairs
[/olist]


Some bugs have been fixed.





Important :
If you have a Saved Game, delete it and 
Start a New Game.

notes.title: Patch Notes No Man's Island Demo
notes.notes:
Welcome to No Man's Island! Today we are launching the demo version 1.04 of our game and we are so excited about it! We listened to your feedback and made a lot of changes. If you have an idea how we could improve the game, please let us know in the feedback section or send us a message. So go ahead, play and enjoy!

Patch notes "Demo": 

The demo has now no day's limit: you can play as long as you wish. In the demo version you have limited crafting possibilities and you can only move within one biome.



 Added Map (key: M)
 Item icon's background in the crafting menu is now green when the player has all required materials for crafting it
 Added 2 Bosses: Ent  and  Cyclops
 Added new Animal: Fox
 Added recipe Alchemy Table (The recipe is dropped from the Enemy Chest in the Crypt (Dungeon))
 Added Ent Item
 Added Cyclope Item
 Added Background Music
 Added item Saw. Saw is needed in order to Refine Wood
 Added message "Inventory is Full"
 Added Crafting queue for crafting more than one Item
 Added "Water Well" in the starting area
 Added "Dragon Egg" Use it on the alchemy table to create your Pet
 Added "Cane plant" and "Sugar ingredient" 
 Renamed Material "Skin" to "Rabbit Skin"



Important :
If you have a Saved Game, delete it and 
Start a New Game.
